name: ILFORD PAN F PLUS
process: ILFORD ILFOTEC HC (1+31), 4 min at 20°C/68°F, intermittent agitation (roll film; representative of 35 mm)

source.title: ILFORD PAN F PLUS — Technical Information (HARMAN technology)

characteristicCurves.logExposureUnits: relative log exposure (arbitrary origin, as labelled on the chart)
characteristicCurves.condition: ILFORD ILFOTEC HC (1+31), 4 min at 20°C/68°F, intermittent agitation (roll film; representative of 35 mm)
characteristicCurves.notes: x axis is relative log exposure 0-4.5 with no absolute origin, so the curve cannot be placed against lux-seconds from this datasheet. Density type and exposure illuminant are not stated. dMin = base + fog at the lowest plotted exposure. Grid: 0.5 log E x 0.5 D, checked against the 1-4 and 1.0 / 2.0 labels.

spectralSensitivity.units: relative sensitivity as labelled (ticks 0.5 and 1.0; zero at the chart floor)
spectralSensitivity.exposure: wedge spectrogram to tungsten light (2850 K)
spectralSensitivity.notes: Ilford publishes a wedge-spectrogram outline with a "Sensitivity" axis marked 0.5 and 1.0 and does not say whether the scale is linear or logarithmic (a wedge spectrogram's height is proportional to log sensitivity). Values are read on the printed scale (the chart floor is ≈0). No density criterion is given. x calibrated on the centres of the wavelength labels (no tick marks drawn).

granularity.notes: No granularity figure is published in this datasheet.

notes: ISO 50/18° daylight (ID-11, 20°C, spiral tank). Best at EI 50/18; good results at EI 25/15. Development times are tabulated for EI 25, 50 and 64 (e.g. ID-11 stock 4½ / 6½ min, DD-X 1+4 7 / 8 min at 20°C); accidental exposure at EI 100-200+ is covered only by a rescue table.
Reciprocity: none from 1/2 s to 1/10,000 s; longer metered times Tm need Ta = Tm^1.33 (seconds).

35 mm on 0.125 mm acetate base; roll film on 0.110 mm clear acetate with an anti-halation backing that clears in development; large-format sheet film on 0.180 mm polyester base with anti-halation backing.
Ilford recommends processing PAN F Plus within 3 months of exposure (latent-image stability).
No MTF, resolving power or granularity data are published (mtf and granularity null).

derived.note: Computed by extract.py from the digitised curves as sanity checks; not published values.
derived.gammaMethod: least-squares slope over the central 25-75% of each curve's density range

extraction.notes: Embedded bitmaps (~1.8-4.9 px/pt). Characteristic axes from the grid lines; spectrogram x from the wavelength-label centres and y from the two tick marks.
